DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", stretch_id as "stretchId", default_location_id as "defaultLocationId", operational_plan_url as "operationalPlanUrl", valid_for_min as "validForMin", alias as "alias", description as "description", multi_instance as "multiInstance", cctv_scenario_id as "cctvScenarioId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.ims_incident_type_stretchs WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.ims_incident_type_stretchs (incident_type_id, stretch_id, default_location_id, operational_plan_url, valid_for_min, alias, description, multi_instance, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentTypeId, :stretchId, :defaultLocationId, :operationalPlanUrl, :validForMin, :alias, :description, :multiInstance, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.ims_incident_type_stretchs SET default_location_id = :defaultLocationId, operational_plan_url = :operationalPlanUrl, valid_for_min = :validForMin, alias = :alias, description = :description, multi_instance = :multiInstance, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId AND stretch_id = :stretchId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.ims_incident_type_stretchs WHERE incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId AND stretch_id = :stretchId
